chapter_title: Dxun: the Mandalorian camp and the shuttle to Iziz
about: Story state every completed run of the chapter ends with, for a skip-to-the-end feature. Curated in tools/questdb/chapters.py; values marked certain = false were worked out by reading the scripts or seen in one real save, not proven for every run.

cleared_note: How each module looks after a full run, for an editor that stores the area as played: remove (tag, template), doors (tag: open, unlocked), containers_looted (container tags the rewards file empties), locals (the area's, the module's and placed objects' local variables their own scripts read to tell a first visit from a return, with the value a played area holds; index = the engine's local slot). returnable = false: the player never comes back to the module. returnable_note: after the first visit every later landing on the moon goes to 401dxn (k_sup_galaxymap: 401DXN_Visited set, 003EBO_RETURN_DEST 4) and the camp is reached on foot, so 401dxn to 404dxn come back. 421dxn is the one-time turret fight of the arrival; the tomb (410dxn, 411dxn) is played later, in the Onderon chapter, so it is not stored as played here
